|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Once per game, may ▼Undercover on Labria. Once during your control phase, may reveal top card of your Reserve Deck to both players. May place revealed card on your Reserve Deck, Force Pile, or Used Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Labria (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Once per game, may deploy Undercover on Labria from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your control phase, may reveal top card of Reserve Deck. Place revealed card on top of Force Pile, Reserve Deck, or Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' “▼Undercover” → “deploy Undercover”; “Labria. Once during” → “Labria from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During”; removed “your”; “Deck to both players. May place” → “Deck. Place”; “your” → “top of Force Pile,”; removed “Force Pile,”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 40.
